newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX higher.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot diesel fuel prices moved higher on Friday on firming NYMEX front-month heating oil futures and steady differentials, traders said.
Traders said the market had adjusted to trimmed production at Clark Refining and Marketing Co's 80,515 barrel per day Blue Island, Ill., refinery following a fire Saturday.

Traders said the market was watching closely developments in an Illinois court, where state regulators are seeking a court order to temporarily shut the refinery following a series of accidents over the past two years.
Low sulphur diesel for late-October deliveries was talked unchanged at bids 4.0 cents over NYMEX November heating oil in Group Three and even with the print in Chicago.
High sulphur diesel for all October timings was bid even with the print in Group Three and unchanged at 1.75 cent under the print in Chicago.
Late-October unleaded gasoline barrels were bid even with NYMEX November unleaded in Group Three and 0.25 cent a gallon weaker in Chicago.
Jet/kero in early Friday discussion was steady at 2.75/3.0 cents a gallon over the print in Group Three and 2.0/2.25 cents over in Chicago.
